$comment: Source-ownership declaration for the S05 P0 package-boundary freeze. Read by script/check-package-boundary.mjs. Matching is longest-prefix-wins over POSIX repo-relative paths; a directory entry can be overridden by a file entry beneath it. See rasen/changes/s05-package-boundary-freeze/design.md D2/D3/D4 for the measurements that produced this map. Consumers (s05-second-host task 2.2) are objects { id, root, ownership? }: root is the POSIX repo-relative scan root (longest wins), and ownership "map" means files under the root are still resolved through the ownership map below (the web arrangement); without it, every file under the root belongs to the consumer id outright.

ownership.why: The one complete surface a Host author implements. Zero dependencies, no React, no DOM — spec §3.5's install, mechanically (design D1). Moved from apps/web/src/editor/ports by S05 P1 task 3.1; this entry is now vestigial against the generic packages/*/src rule (task 2.1) and kept only so the why below stays attached to the file.

D3: ports/index.ts re-exports EditorHostNavigation from this module as the frozen name NavigationHost, and this module imports @/editor/ports — a live type-only module cycle today. Splitting the two directories into different packages would turn it into a package cycle. Assigning this file to editor-ports resolves the cycle without editing the frozen re-export.
